data.name: Elemental Strike
data.description: You draw upon your extraplanar heritage to imbue your weapons with elemental energies. As a swift action, you can imbue your weapons with elemental energy. For 1 round, your weapons deal an additional points of energy damage. The type of energy damage depends on your race: acid for oread, electricity for sylph, fire for ifrit, or cold for undine. Special:[NOT IMPLEMENTED] You can use this feat instead of Arcane Strike to qualify for or attack with the Deadly Dealer feat.
